Hi Marissa,

Quick note from AP — we attempted to run the card on file for Inv-2026-884 this morning and it was declined by the issuer (reason: authorization hold). Our AP desk can switch to wire, or we can activate a single-use virtual card if you support that flow.

A couple of constraints on our side:
- This vendor is subject to a 7% withholding tax (local regulation). We need confirmation whether Redwood will accept gross payment and provide a WHT certificate, or if you will net the invoice.
- Our treasury needs bank details (routing + account + beneficiary name) and a remittance reference to reconcile the payment.

Can you confirm preferred fallback (wire vs virtual card) and whether Redwood can provide the appropriate tax documentation? We’re aiming to clear this by COB Mon (23 Nov).

Thanks —
